source.snippet: I wish there was a tool to sandbox Windows applications; not primarily for security reasons but mostly because of the immense amount of trash left behind all over %APPDATA% and other random disk locations, the registry, etc. I wish I could start a command line (terminal) that will virtualize the file system in a 'workspace' such that any crap that would otherwise pollute my system drive ends up in a neat box on my 'work' drive.

problem_statement: Windows power users and developers are frustrated by applications scattering files across AppData, the registry, and random disk locations, and want a sandboxing or filesystem virtualisation tool that cleanly isolates app side-effects per workspace without the limitations of Windows Sandbox.
target_segment: Windows developers, sysadmins, and technical power users who manage multiple projects or client environments on a single machine.
notes: Older signal (2020) but the underlying pain is persistent and unresolved — Windows Sandbox is too heavyweight and requires Enterprise SKU. Expressed as 'I wish I could' with a concrete use-case. Buyer signal moderate: developers and consultants who manage clean environments would pay for a lightweight tool; similar to how Sandboxie had commercial tiers.
